test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The security asked him who he was and which flat he wished to visit.

options.text: The security said, “Who are you? Which flat do you wish to visit?”
The security said, “Who are you? Which flat are you wishing to visit?”
The security said, “Who are you? Which flat you wish to be visited?”
The security said, “Who are you? Which flat you wished to visit?”

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Indirect Speech** and we have to change it into **Direct Speech**.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting **direct speech** into **indirect speech**:
 
 
• There will be no change in reporting verb because we know that the given sentence is **interrogative** with a **question word**.
 
• **Comma** and **inverted commas **will be added.
 
• **"Who"** will be used as a **conjunction** because we know that in an interrogative sentence with a question word, the question word itself becomes the conjunction.
 
• The auxiliary verb **"was"** will be changed into** "are"**.
 
• **"He"** will be changed into** "you"** because in direct to indirect transformation second-person pronoun **(you)** is changed according to the object of reporting verb that is** "the security"**. 
 
• **"Him"** will be changed into **"me"**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the direct speech of the given sentence is: **"The security said, “Who are you? Which flat do you wish to visit?”.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The conjunction** "whether/if"** is used if the reported speech begins with words other than **wh-family words**.
 
• **Example**:
 
 
• *He said to me, "Can you help me?"*
 
• *He asked me if I could help him.*
